score.removeNoteDescription: This creates a new version and removes the note from the numbered annotations. Notes from the original recognition are not affected.

guide.title: A little space for music
guide.description: Read the notes on the original score and begin practicing at ease.
guide.step1Body: Supports PDFs up to 20 MB and 30 pages, plus JPG and PNG. PDFs are recognized page by page; images are treated as single pages.
guide.step2Body: Click a notehead to change its pitch, or drag the numbers to reposition them. Choose annotation size and color in the inspector; annotations that cannot avoid the score stay pending until you confirm them after saving.
guide.step3Title: Save a revision, then take the music with you
guide.step3Body: Every save is its own revision, and exports match the saved revision. Local records contain access credentials; if you clear browser data, upload the file again.
guide.itemExportPage: Export this page as PDF (original view)
guide.noteWindowsMac: Ctrl applies to Windows and ⌘ to macOS. Text fields, menus, and dialogs keep their native keyboard behavior; save and help still work from a text field. Select-all and batch actions apply to the current page only, and unsaved drafts are kept when you change pages.
guide.noteNotation: Movable do needs a confirmed tonic; natural minor's tonic is written as 6. Measure numbers start from the page's first physical measure, including pickup measures. Automatic recognition is not proofreading; numbers show pitch, not fingering.

inspector.title: Proofread & annotate
inspector.scopeSelected: Applies only to selected annotations; drag a marquee on the score to select several.
inspector.scopePage: Applies to every annotation on this page; the preview updates immediately.
inspector.sizeHelp: Auto makes single notes largest, then shrinks chords of two, three, or more notes in steps; saving rechecks the margins, down to 3 pt. A fixed size keeps the size you choose.
inspector.recalcHint: Apply the latest layout rules and create a new revision; save unsaved changes first.
inspector.fixedHelp: Based on C4 = 1, with accidentals and octave dots preserved.
inspector.movableHelp: You confirm the tonic and mode; the key is never guessed.
inspector.pitchChanged: Pitch changed; the numbered glyph updates after saving.
inspector.dragHelp: Drag the numbers to reposition; use arrow keys to nudge and Shift for larger steps. Margins are rechecked on save; positions covering the score are not written to the PDF.
inspector.emptyLine1: Click a note in the score
inspector.emptyLine2: to adjust its pitch and annotation here
inspector.reviewText: Automatic recognition needs manual proofreading. Numbers show pitch, not fingering.
inspector.unresolvedRhythm: {count} notes on this page have an undetermined rhythmic voice; pitch annotations are kept — proofread them closely.
inspector.unresolvedToastTitle: {count} notes on this page need review
inspector.unresolvedToastHint: Their rhythmic voice is undetermined; pitch annotations are kept — proofread them closely.
inspector.incompleteKey: The key signature is incomplete for {count} notes on this page; check the accidentals at key changes.
inspector.rejectedHeader: Ignored {count} octave-mark candidates misread from the header area. Compare this page's actual octave lines and pitches with the original.
